summary: TTM Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive securities purchase agreement dated August 15, 2026, under which its wholly-owned subsidiary, TTM Technologies North America, LLC, agreed to acquire all membership interests of Epiq Solutions (EDS Intermediate Holding, LLC) from EDS TopCo, LP for $1.1 billion in cash, subject to working capital adjustments. The board unanimously approved the transaction; TTM guarantees the buyer's obligations. Closing conditions include HSR clearance and absence of injunctions. No indemnification; buyer secured R&W insurance. Transaction implies significant valuation; watch regulatory approval and closing timeline for spread convergence.
